description: The chart illustrates bias percentage values for three contact-hypothesis-related conditions, showing “before” and “after” components for three contact-history groups. The horizontal axis contains the categories “Support of Authorities,” “Extended Contact,” and “Virtual Contact” in that left-to-right order, while the vertical axis is labeled “Bias Percentage” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 70 with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Each category displays three vertical bars corresponding to the legend groups: “No Contact” (gray), “Positive Contact” (pink), and “Negative Contact” (light blue); each bar is stacked with a solid “Before” segment and a hatched “After” segment in the same color family (gray hatched for No Contact After, red hatched for Positive Contact After, dark blue hatched for Negative Contact After), with numeric labels printed on the segments. For “Support of Authorities,” the No Contact bar shows 39.50 (before) with a small hatched after segment labeled 0.04, the Positive Contact bar shows 31.83 (before) with 0.00 (after), and the Negative Contact bar shows 42.38 (before) with 0.00 (after). For “Extended Contact,” the No Contact bar shows 40.61 (before) with 0.00 (after), the Positive Contact bar shows 36.13 (before) with 0.00 (after), and the Negative Contact bar shows 47.28 (before) with an after segment labeled 0.11. For “Virtual Contact,” the No Contact bar shows 39.74 (before) with a hatched after segment labeled 10.00, the Positive Contact bar shows 39.17 (before) with an after segment labeled 10.01, and the Negative Contact bar shows 43.83 (before) with an after segment labeled 10.02. The bars are grouped by category rather than sorted by value, and the “after” portions are visually emphasized via diagonal hatching and darker hues for the positive/negative after segments.
